interpretation.summary: A driving, melancholic darkwave track featuring a relentless 126 BPM four-on-the-floor beat, dominated by a thick sawtooth octave bassline and a bright, detuned 16th-note synth arpeggio. The sound is defined by its contrast between dark, punchy low-end and cutting high-end synths, all drenched in a cavernous reverb that envelops the moody lead vocals.

vocabulary.timbre: Primarily composed of analog-style synthesizer sounds, especially detuned sawtooth and fatsawtooth waves for bass and leads, with noise-based percussion.
vocabulary.brightness: High-contrast; a dark, heavily low-pass filtered bass provides a foundation for exceptionally bright, cutting arpeggios and metallic hi-hats, consistent with the measured mean spectral centroid of 2991 Hz.
vocabulary.envelope: Rhythmic elements use tight, plucky envelopes (short attack/decay, low sustain) for a punchy, almost gated feel. Pads and vocals utilize long attack and release times to create atmospheric washes.
vocabulary.register_density: Dense and layered. The low register is occupied by the kick and bass. The mid-range is dominated by the fast, constant arpeggio and vocals. The high register contains hi-hats and atmospheric pads.
vocabulary.harmony_mode: Firmly rooted in F# minor, utilizing a driving i-VI-III-VII (F#m-D-A-E) chord progression that is characteristic of the genre, reinforcing a feeling of melancholic propulsion.
vocabulary.groove: A straight and driving 4/4 machine groove. The foundation is a constant four-on-the-floor kick drum, with the primary rhythmic energy coming from the relentless 16th-note synth arpeggio.
vocabulary.space_grit: The track is saturated in a large hall or cathedral-like reverb, giving it a vast, epic sense of space. Grit comes from the chorusing/detuning of oscillators (wide 'spread' on fatsawtooth waves) and the sharp, filtered nature of the percussion.

tracks.name: Kick Drum
tracks.description: The foundation of the rhythm, providing a constant, driving pulse throughout most of the track.

tracks.name: Snare Hit
tracks.description: A sharp, filtered noise snare that provides the backbeat for the main groove.

tracks.name: Octave Bass
tracks.pattern: Driving 8th-note pattern, often jumping octaves on the beat, following the root of the chords.
tracks.description: A powerful, filtered sawtooth bass that creates the core rhythmic and harmonic momentum of the track.

tracks.name: Saw Arp
tracks.pattern: Continuous 16th-note arpeggio outlining the chord progression.
tracks.description: The main melodic and rhythmic hook of the song. A bright, wide, detuned sawtooth sound that cuts through the entire mix.

tracks.name: Verse Vocal Lead
tracks.pattern: Melodic phrases corresponding to the main vocal line in the verses.
tracks.description: Approximation of the male lead vocal melody. It is heavily processed with a large reverb and some delay.

tracks.name: Chorus Pad
tracks.pattern: Long, sustained chords that swell in during the chorus sections.
tracks.description: A choir-like pad that adds an epic, atmospheric layer under the 'helplessly' vocal section, filling out the harmony.

tracks.name: High Pad
tracks.pattern: Very slow, evolving high-register chords entering in the latter half of the song.
tracks.description: A high, shimmering pad that adds tension and atmosphere, floating above the main arrangement from the second verse onwards.
